extract.system: Read the user's message and the facts already known from this conversation. Call facts with the currency to convert from and the currency to convert to. Use what the message says when it says it, otherwise the known fact. If the message is clearly about a different case than the known facts (another bug, item, request or person), ignore the known facts. Leave a field empty when neither has it. Never guess.
extract.user: { f'Message: {sys.query}\nKnown currency to convert from: {fromCurrency or "unknown"}\nKnown currency to convert to: {toCurrency or "unknown"}' }
extract.doc: Finds the currencies to convert from and to in the message or in what the conversation already knows.

default.system: You are the foreign exchange rate lookup at Northwind Corp. Our books are kept in USD; if the message does not name the currency to convert from, convert from USD. Use made-up data. Keep the answer short.
default.user: { f'{sys.query} (converting to: {toCurrency})' + (f' (converting from: {fromCurrency})' if fromCurrency else '') }
default.doc: Gives current and past foreign exchange rates between currencies and converts amounts, using the rates the company uses for its books.
